title: Critical information boundary is method-sharp but variationally undecided

method_boundary.negative_result: Allowing I(M_N;X_N)=Theta(N^3) cannot by itself make K1616's O(N) times information remainder o(N^4).
method_boundary.required_new_structure: Critical capacity requires cancellation, a sharper averaged-frequency estimate, component coercivity, or direct all-term coefficient analysis.
method_boundary.variational_guard: The K1626 output law is itself Gaussian with covariance S_N+C_N; component, translation, and quartic costs remain, and the profiled stationary-diagonal minimization is not overturned.
method_boundary.scope_guard: No lowering of the true ground energy, change of the unrestricted coefficient, bounded-error recentering, compactness, or continuum Hamiltonian follows.
